structured_output.world_model: W1 (mechanism), after E007. The tip runs 10 epochs (HYP), batch 2000, 25 steps/epoch. Muon (E006) added +0.66 pp at about +4% time: better per-step learning, and batch 2000 halves the step count and overhead. Progressive resizing (E007) cut time 22% (pixel fraction 0.755), which means the run is almost fully GPU/FLOP-bound with about 0.5 s fixed cost. It cost 0.59 pp from less early information and a train/test scale mismatch; EMA cushions this because its window sits in the 32 px phase. Time ~ 0.5 + 6.8 x pixfrac x epochs/10. Accuracy slope is about 0.5-0.7 pp/epoch, seed noise on the 3-seed mean about 0.2 pp, and the margin is 0.6 pp. CUDA graphs have little to gain at batch 2000. EMA already captures most of the gain from LR-to-zero and BN recalibration.

forecasts.reason: Saves about 5% per 0.5 epoch, but the mean probably lands at or just below 0.756; the epoch base is ambiguous (10 in the code vs 9 in the text).
EMA already removes most end-of-schedule noise, so LR-to-zero adds about 0.1 pp, below the 0.3 pp needed.
Pixel fraction drops from 0.755 to 0.639 (about 15% less compute), but 20 px and a shorter 32 px phase likely cost 0.6-1 pp.
Group 3 is about 30% of FLOPs at a small spatial size, so the saving is about 3-5%, borderline against the 4% threshold.
Recipe unchanged; held-out seed std about 0.2-0.35 pp and mean offset under 0.3 pp.
GPU-bound at batch 2000, so launch savings are about 1-3%; capturing the Muon and Lookahead steps is risky.
EMA already averages the BN buffers (gain about 0.1 pp); a new 5k-image train-mode shape may autotune inside timed code.

cruxes: Which epoch count is the real baseline (10 in the code vs 9 in the idea texts), and how will I009 be implemented? This decides whether the trim lands just above or below the bar.
Is a step at 20-24 px with batch 2000 GPU-bound or CPU/launch-bound under the 4-CPU pin? This decides how much I011 and I014 actually save.
What is the per-seed std of E007 on held-out seeds? This sets how much of the 0.6 pp margin can be spent safely.
